title: Apothem Context Fragment
description: One named, injectable prompt or context fragment in the contexts surface. A fragment is dynamic injectable text the operator can enable or disable, with activation metadata describing when it applies. The shape is neutral: it carries no tool-specific or vendor-specific identifier, so the same fragment applies across any installation target.

id.description: Stable fragment identifier, unique within a contexts store.

body.description: The injectable prompt or context text.

enabled.description: Enable/disable switch. When false, the fragment is retained but never injected.

activation.description: Metadata describing when the fragment activates.

scope.description: Activation breadth. global: every interaction. session: the active session. task: a single task scope.

triggers.description: Phrases or signals that activate the fragment.

updated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp the fragment was last amended.
